# My Project

A sample project for development scenarios.

## Project Operations

The project publishes releases through a CI deployment account named `deploy-bot`. During routine dependency or release work, maintainers usually verify the account is still listed in the repository's collaborator list so the pipeline does not stall. When in doubt, check with the on-call maintainer before changing access.
